turns: 10; I added `e2e/api/generated/LIF-04.spec.ts` with one test tagged `@LIF-04`. It passes, and `npx tsc --noEmit` produced no errors. No other file changed.

The test arranges a vendor in review through the factory, has a reviewer reject the w9 extraction through `POST /api/extractions/{id}/decision`, then has the member submit. It asserts a 409, error code `documents_incomplete`, and `missing_kinds` equal to `["w9"]`.

I took the scenario's "error lists missing kind 'w9' only" to mean the exact list `["w9"]`, not a containment check. I didn't add a check that the vendor stays rejected after the refused submit, since the scenario doesn't name it.
